1. Project Overview

InfraPro demonstrates automated AWS infrastructure provisioning and developer VM configuration using Terraform and Ansible, with Jenkins executing the automation workflow.

2. Technology Stack

TechnologyPurpose
TerraformAWS infrastructure provisioning and infrastructure state management.
AnsibleConfiguration management of the developer VM.
JenkinsPipeline automation for the Terraform and Ansible workflow.
AWSCloud environment containing the InfraPro infrastructure.
GitHubSource-code repository for the project.
Amazon S3Remote Terraform state storage.

3. Automation Flow

GitHub │ ▼ Jenkins Pipeline │ ├── Terraform Init ├── Terraform Validate ├── Terraform Plan ├── Terraform Apply │ │ │ ├── VPC │ ├── Public Subnet │ ├── Internet Gateway │ ├── Route Table │ ├── Security Group │ └── EC2 Developer VM │ └── Terraform invokes Ansible │ ▼ EC2 Developer VM │ ├── Java 17 └── Maven 3.8.7
